# Appendix

## Mathematical derivations/proofs

### Bayes error with idiosyncratic shocks

A perfect Bayes classifier considering the idiosyncratic shock as defined in 
@eq-pd-with-shock-perf-bayes has an analytical solution for the Bayes error.
To get to this expression, I use the results of @Ripley_1996. The decision
to classify an applicant as bad occurs if

$$
\mathbb{P}(Y=b | X = x) > \mathbb{P}(Y=g | X = x)
$$
